title: finding(plugin-detail,plugin-dashboard,security): `RelatedList` and `ObjectDataTable` draw a password / secret column as the mask but never set `TableColumn.masked`, so Ctrl+C on the masked cell copies the RAW value
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with named sites (class a · security). A credential drawn as `••••••` is still handed out raw by the data table, in two more producers of its columns. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`) from the objectui#10583 dev report (PR objectui#10643, round 1 and round 2, "noted, not filed"). The round-1 contract review of that PR confirmed it at source. ⛔ Not graded here.

## Context

PR objectui#10643 (objectui#10583, in review) gives `TableColumn` a declared key, `masked?: boolean`. It makes `data-table` refuse a masked column's raw value on Ctrl+C / Cmd+C, the cell `title` tooltip, the table's CSV export and inline edit. The rule is not restated in `components`: the PRODUCER asks `isMaskedFieldType()` (objectui#8686), and the table obeys the flag. `ObjectGrid` is the only producer that sets it in that PR.

## Sites (the PR objectui#10643 reviewer's reading; ⛔ not re-read by the seat)

- `RelatedList.normalizeColumn` in `@object-ui/plugin-detail`;
- `ObjectDataTable.normalizeColumns` in `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`.

Both draw a `password` cell as the mask through `getCellRenderer`, and neither mentions `masked` (grep: 0 hits).

## Measurement (the dev's throwaway probe on `bcec471b8`; ⛔ not re-run by the seat)

Both drew `••••••`. The raw value was in `innerHTML` (the cell `title`), not in the text, and Ctrl+C on the masked `td` wrote `RAW-PROBE-10583`.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Once PR objectui#10643 lands, each producer sets `masked` from `isMaskedFieldType()`, with the same narrow-only union `ObjectGrid` uses (`isMaskedGridColumn`: masked if either the view-authored type or the object-declared type is masked). Pin Ctrl+C, the tooltip and export on each producer, each with a `text` control. ⛔ Serial: this depends on PR objectui#10643 merging first.

## Dedupe

REST read of every objectui issue and PR updated since 2026-09-24T00:00Z (740 items), titles matched against `mask|password|secret|RelatedList|ObjectDataTable|oracle`: no card for these two producers. The hits are objectui#10583 / PR objectui#10643 (the grid), objectui#10639 (the readonly `PasswordField` on empty), objectui#8686, objectui#8678 and objectui#10373 (lookup FLS), none about these producers' copy path. The regex walk over the 1000 most recently updated items, `masked.*(RelatedList|ObjectDataTable)` in either order, gives no hit on this defect.

Dedupe words: `RelatedList masked copy` · `ObjectDataTable password clipboard` · `masked flag second producer` · `related list secret Ctrl+C raw`
